records.jp: この本は、山田さんの想いみたい
records.en_original: This book seems to capture how Niina feels.
records.en: This book seems to capture how Niina feels.

records.jp: 世界を愛せない私を
records.en_original: A world that I can't love—
records.en: A world that I can't love—

records.jp: 世界が愛すことはない
records.en_original: —would never love me back.
records.en: —would never love me back.

records.jp: 生まれながらの最悪な環境
records.en_original: I was born into the worst possible circumstances.
records.en: I was born into the worst possible circumstances.

records.jp: 忘れたくても忘れられない、忌々しい記憶
records.en_original: Bitter memories I can't forget, no matter how much I want to.
records.en: Bitter memories I can't forget, no matter how much I want to.

records.jp: アタシは絶望の淵に立たされ、自暴自棄になって<CR>破滅の道へ進もうとしていた
records.en_original: Standing at the edge of despair, I gave up on everything, ready to walk the path of ruin.
records.en: Standing at the edge of despair, I gave up on everything, ready to walk the path of ruin.

records.jp: そんなアタシに手を差し伸べてくれたのが、<CR>お姉さまだった
records.en_original: Sister was the one who reached out to me then.
records.en: Sister was the one who reached out to me then.

records.jp: アタシの抱えている絶望が欲しいと言ってくれた
records.en_original: She told me she wanted to help carry the despair I held inside.
records.en: She told me she wanted to help carry the despair I held inside.

records.jp: 生まれて初めて、誰かに必要とされ、求められた瞬間
records.en_original: For the first time in my life, I was needed by someone—longed for by someone.
records.en: For the first time in my life, I was needed by someone—longed for by someone.

records.jp: 生きててよかったと、初めて思った<CR>大切な思い出
records.en_original: That was the first time I ever felt truly glad to be alive—an irreplaceable memory.
records.en: That was the first time I ever felt truly glad to be alive—an irreplaceable memory.

records.jp: だから、あの時に誓ったんだ
records.en_original: That's why I made a vow back then.
records.en: That's why I made a vow back then.

records.jp: アタシを必要としてくれたお姉さまのためなら、<CR>どんなことでもしようと
records.en_original: If it was for Sister—who actually needed me—I'd do anything.
records.en: If it was for Sister—who actually needed me—I'd do anything.

records.jp: 残りの人生すべてを捧げようと
records.en_original: I swore to dedicate the rest of my life to her.
records.en: I swore to dedicate the rest of my life to her.

records.jp: お姉さまもアタシのことを、何より大切な存在と<CR>思ってくれていると信じたから
records.en_original: I thought I was the most important thing in the world to her, too.
records.en: I thought I was the most important thing in the world to her, too.

records.jp: けど、それは勘違いだった
records.en_original: But I was completely mistaken.
records.en: But I was completely mistaken.

records.jp: お姉さまが何より大事にしていたのは、<CR>実の妹の陽桜莉
records.en_original: The one she truly cared about above all else was her real sister, Hiori.
records.en: The one she truly cared about above all else was her real sister, Hiori.

records.jp: アタシに手を差し伸べたのは、すべて陽桜莉のため
records.en_original: The only reason she had reached out to me was for Hiori's sake.
records.en: The only reason she had reached out to me was for Hiori's sake.

records.jp: 深い絶望を持つリフレクターのフラグメントを、<CR>アタシから引き抜くためだった
records.en_original: She only wanted to extract the Fragment of a Reflector filled with deep despair from within me.
records.en: She only wanted to extract the Fragment of a Reflector filled with deep despair from within me.

records.jp: お姉さまに想われていないアタシに、価値はない。<CR>間違った存在の自分は存在しちゃいけない
records.en_original: If she didn't care for me, then I was worthless. Someone like me shouldn't exist in the first place.
records.en: If she didn't care for me, then I was worthless. Someone like me shouldn't exist in the first place.

records.jp: アタシが愛さなかったのは世界だけじゃない。<CR>自分自身すらも、愛せていなかった
records.en_original: It wasn't just the world I couldn't love. I couldn't even love myself.
records.en: It wasn't just the world I couldn't love. I couldn't even love myself.

records.jp: けど、そんなアタシを救ってくれたのが陽桜莉だった
records.en_original: But it was Hiori who saved me in the end.
records.en: But it was Hiori who saved me in the end.

records.jp: 皮肉なことに、一番憎んでいた<CR>お姉さまの妹に、救われてしまった
records.en_original: Ironically, the person I hated most—Sister's actual sister—was the one who saved me.
records.en: Ironically, the person I hated most—Sister's actual sister—was the one who saved me.

records.jp: アタシのお姉さまに対する大切な想いも、<CR>守られてしまった
records.en_original: Even the precious feelings I had for Sister...she protected them for me.
records.en: Even the precious feelings I had for Sister...she protected them for me.

records.jp: ――いや
records.en_original: No...
records.en: No...

records.jp: 今ならハッキリと言える
records.en_original: I can say it clearly now.
records.en: I can say it clearly now.

records.jp: アタシの大切な想いは、陽桜莉に守ってもらえた
records.en_original: The feelings that meant so much to me were protected by Hiori herself.
records.en: The feelings that meant so much to me were protected by Hiori herself.

records.jp: もう、お姉さまに出会う前のアタシには戻りたくない
records.en_original: I never want to go back to the person I was before I met Sister.
records.en: I never want to go back to the person I was before I met Sister.

records.jp: お姉さまに出会ったことで知った本当の自分。<CR>それをもう、手放したりしない
records.en_original: I found my real self after meeting her. There's no way I'd ever let that go now.
records.en: I found my real self after meeting her. There's no way I'd ever let that go now.

records.jp: お姉さまがどう思っていようと、<CR>そんなのは関係ない
records.en_original: It doesn't matter what Sister thinks anymore.
records.en: It doesn't matter what Sister thinks anymore.

records.jp: アタシのお姉さまに対するこの想いは、本物なのだから
records.en_original: Because what I feel for her is real.
records.en: Because what I feel for her is real.

records.jp: それでもアタシは信じたい
records.en_original: Even so, I still want to believe.
records.en: Even so, I still want to believe.

records.jp: 善は虚構ではなく、幸福は真実だと
records.en_original: That goodness isn't a lie, and that happiness is real.
records.en: That goodness isn't a lie, and that happiness is real.

records.jp: 大勢の人間の想いを助けたおまえたちの想いが、<CR>そんな簡単に変えられてたまるか
records.en_original: You helped the hearts of so many—there's no way your feelings can be changed that easily.
records.en: You helped the hearts of so many—there's no way your feelings can be changed that easily.

records.jp: 紫乃を止められるのは、おまえらだけだ。<CR>さっさと行け！！
records.en_original: You two are the only ones who can stop Shino. Hurry up and go!
records.en: You two are the only ones who can stop Shino. Hurry up and go!

records.jp: 瑠夏ちゃん、今のって！
records.en_original: Ruka, did you see that just now?!
records.en: Ruka, did you see that just now?!

records.jp: また、山田さんに助けられて、怒られちゃったみたい
records.en_original: Looks like Niina helped and scolded us yet again.
records.en: Looks like Niina helped and scolded us yet again.

records.jp: うん……私ね、最初は仁菜ちゃんのこと、<CR>ちょっと怖い子だと思ってた
records.en_original: Yeah... At first, I honestly thought Niina was a little scary.
records.en: Yeah... At first, I honestly thought Niina was a little scary.

records.jp: けど、それって誰よりも必死で、<CR>毎日生きることに真剣だからそう見えたんだ
records.en_original: But that's just because she was more desperate than anyone. Everyday life was a struggle for her.
records.en: But that's just because she was more desperate than anyone. Everyday life was a struggle for her.

records.jp: 仁菜ちゃんの想いに触れて、<CR>ようやくそれがわかった
records.en_original: I finally understood that after touching her feelings.
records.en: I finally understood that after touching her feelings.

records.jp: うん。だからこそ私たちの味方になってくれた今は、<CR>すごく心強い
records.en_original: Yeah. That's why it feels so reassuring knowing she's on our side now.
records.en: Yeah. That's why it feels so reassuring knowing she's on our side now.

records.jp: 戦いでも、想いの面でも、何度も助けてくれたし
records.en_original: She's been a huge support for us both in battle and emotionally.
records.en: She's been a huge support for us both in battle and emotionally.

records.jp: 私たちの心が折れかけた時も、<CR>覚悟が足りないってすっごく怒ってくれたしね
records.en_original: Even when our hearts started to break, she'd get really mad at us for not being strong enough.
records.en: Even when our hearts started to break, she'd get really mad at us for not being strong enough.

records.jp: ……あの時も、怖かったなぁ
records.en_original: She really scared me back then, too...
records.en: She really scared me back then, too...

records.jp: 私たちも山田さんに負けないくらいに成長して、<CR>少しは怒られないようにならないとだね
records.en_original: We need to grow so we won't lose to Niina, and so she won't have anything to scold us for anymore.
records.en: We need to grow so we won't lose to Niina, and so she won't have anything to scold us for anymore.

records.jp: 都ちゃん、仁菜ちゃん、ユズちゃんにライムちゃん
records.en_original: Miyako, Niina, Yuzu, and Lime.
records.en: Miyako, Niina, Yuzu, and Lime.

records.jp: みんな、私たちの大事なお友達で、<CR>心から信頼できる人たちだよね？
records.en_original: They're all our precious friends—people we can truly trust from the bottom of our hearts, right?
records.en: They're all our precious friends—people we can truly trust from the bottom of our hearts, right?

records.jp: 当然じゃない。<CR>どうしたの、突然？
records.en_original: Of course. What's up with you all of a sudden?
records.en: Of course. What's up with you all of a sudden?

records.jp: そんな人たちが心配してる。<CR>想いが変えられてるって……
records.en_original: Those friends are worried about us. Niina said that our feelings have changed...
records.en: Those friends are worried about us. Niina said that our feelings have changed...

records.jp: ……陽桜莉、残りの破片を探そう
records.en_original: Yeah... Let's look for the rest of the shards, Hiori.
records.en: Yeah... Let's look for the rest of the shards, Hiori.

records.jp: 今までのことを思い返しながらフラグメントを<CR>直していけば、何が正しいのかわかるはずだから
records.en_original: If we fix the Fragments while remembering everything that's happened, we should figure out what's right.
records.en: If we fix the Fragments while remembering everything that's happened, we should figure out what's right.

records.jp: うん。急いで探そう
records.en_original: Yeah. Let's hurry and find them.
records.en: Yeah. Let's hurry and find them.
